quest.ars_nouveau:worn_notebook.title: &eWorn Notebook
quest.ars_nouveau:worn_notebook.quest_su: Your first step into Ars Nouveau.
quest.ars_nouveau:worn_notebook.quest_de: &7The &eWorn Notebook&7 is the starting tome of every Ars Nouveau mage.
Craft it from a &6book&7 and a &fFeather&7. Right-click to open the &ein-game guide&7, listing every glyph, ritual, familiar, and machine.
&eUse it to unlock:&7 your first &dGlyphs&7 (Form / Effect / Augment) for spellcrafting.
&6Without this, no spells. Keep it on your hotbar.
quest.ars_nouveau:enchanting_apparatus.q: The heart of Ars Nouveau crafting.
&7The &dEnchanting Apparatus&7 transforms a central item using surrounding &eArcane Pedestals&7.
Place 1 to 8 pedestals around it, drop the recipe ingredients on each, place the main item on the apparatus, then right-click to craft.
&eUsed to craft:&7 Spellbooks, Wands, Magebloom gear, Glyph Press, Imbuement Chamber upgrades, and ritual cores.
&6Requires nearby Source&7 from a Source Jar or Source Relay.
quest.4F8119B6298EA753.title: &bRitual of the Cloudshaping
quest.4F8119B6298EA753.quest_subtitle: Bend the weather to your will.
quest.4F8119B6298EA753.quest_desc: &7Craft a &bRitual Tablet of the Cloudshaping&7 in the Enchanting Apparatus, place it on the ground, and activate it.
&eEffects:&7 toggles the current weather between clear, rain, and thunderstorm.
&eRequires:&7 nearby Source from a Source Jar to fuel the ritual.
&6Perfect for farmers, builders, or summoners who need a specific sky.
quest.0E88FDAE4CB5561B.title: &5Ritual of Awakening
quest.0E88FDAE4CB5561B.quest_subtitle: Give blocks a body and a soul.
quest.0E88FDAE4CB5561B.quest_desc: &7The &5Ritual of Awakening&7 transforms ordinary blocks into living constructs.
Place the ritual tablet near a stack of &eblocks&7 (logs, stones, etc.) and activate it. The blocks rise as a controllable golem-like entity.
&eUseful for:&7 mobile defense, decoration, or simply scaring fellow players.
&6Costs Source — keep a fueled Source Jar nearby.
